# Repository Boundaries

What belongs in this repository — and what does not. Helps agents avoid
scope creep and cross-repo coupling.

## In scope

- Node.js HTTP task API under `src/`.
- In-memory task CRUD behavior and health endpoint.
- Repository-local documentation and Contextum AI context files.
- Agent wrapper instructions that point back to `AGENTS.md`.

## Out of scope (lives elsewhere)

- Durable database infrastructure: none exists in this repository.
- Frontend/UI: none exists in this repository.
- Deployment/hosting configuration: none exists in this repository.
- Authentication/authorization provider: none exists in this repository.
- CI/CD workflow definitions: none exists in this repository.

## Cross-repo contracts

- No cross-repo contracts are declared in repository files.
- The only verified external-facing contract is the HTTP JSON API documented in
  `README.md` and implemented in `src/router.js`.
- Treat downstream consumers as UNKNOWN until a human or external artifact
  identifies them.
